title: Gravity maps of Bradley and Verdery quadrangles
citation: Lawrence, D.P., and Chalcraft, R.G., 1984, Gravity maps of Bradley and Verdery quadrangles: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-35, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: SCGS OFR-35 (Lawrence and Chalcraft, 1984), simple Bouguer gravity maps of the Bradley and Verdery 7.5-minute quadrangles (two sheets): one-milligal gravity contours and gravity stations on topographic bases. No geologic units, structures, drill holes or geologic surfaces; gravity values are geophysical and do not fit the schema, so nothing is recorded (same treatment as other Bouguer maps). SUBSURFACE: none.
